name: Kashima Risako
source:
Occupation: Math teacher, swimming club advisor
Likes: Coffee, sweet rusk, rice balls as a night snack, 
Dislikes: Vinegared dishes, Internet.
Hobbies: Acquiring qualifications, reading mystery novels
Sensitive spots: Vulva, tongue

"A serious and kind teacher admired by everyone"

A beautiful teacher who is serious, hardworking, and loves her student.
She is easy to approach due to her easy-going personality that puts other at ease and a strong sense of chivalry.
Her kind attitude towards the students, and her easy to understand content of her class, makes her a popular teacher.
She always takes students seriously and will do whether to make them flourish.
When she was a schoolgirl, she spent a lot of time studying.
Since then, she lack worldly knowledge and is ignorant of most trends, including sexual ones.
